profile.editHint: Everything here is optional. Each item you add builds trust.

safety.blockBody: They can't message you or respond to your posts, and you won't see their posts. They are not told. You can unblock them any time.

account.deleteBody1: Your business, posts and photos disappear from FMBP right away, and you are logged out.
account.deleteBody2: Changed your mind? Log in with the same number within 30 days and choose “Restore my account”.
account.deleteBody3: After 30 days your personal data is erased for good. Businesses you chatted with still see your old messages, under “Deleted business”.
account.deleteFinal: Your business will be removed from FMBP. Continue?
account.restoreBody: It will be erased for good on {{date}}. You can still restore it, with your business, posts and chats.
account.suspendedBody: FMBP has suspended {{name}} on {{date}}. Other businesses cannot see it or its posts, and you cannot post or chat.
account.suspendedAppeal: If you think this is a mistake, write to {{email}} from this number's business and we will review it.

referral.shareMessage: Join me on FMBP (Find My Business Partner) to find customers, suppliers and partners near you. Enter my invite code {{code}} when you set up your business.
referral.how1: Share your code with a business owner.
referral.how2: They enter it when setting up their business (within 14 days).
referral.how3: When they publish their first post, you get 1 Boost.
referral.how4: A Boost shows one of your live posts in the Boosted row at the top of Latest for 3 days.
referral.how5: Bring 5 businesses and your profile shows “Community builder”.
referral.haveCode: Got an invite code from another business?

errors.invalid_code: This code does not exist. Check it and try again.
errors.already_referred: You already used an invite code.
errors.too_late: A code can be entered only in the first 14 days, before your first post.
errors.no_boosts: You have no Boosts left. Invite businesses to earn more.
errors.post_not_live: Only a live post can be boosted.

referral.onboardingCodeHelp: If another business invited you, enter their code.

role.title: How do you want to continue?
role.hint: This number is an FMBP admin. You can switch any time.
role.userHint: Use FMBP for your business: posts, chats, deals.
role.adminHint: Manage FMBP: reports, verification, businesses, broadcasts.

verify.title: Get verified
verify.verifiedHint: Your profile and posts show the Verified badge.
verify.pendingHint: Sent on {{date}}. It usually takes 1–2 working days. We will notify you.
verify.whyHint: Verified businesses get more replies and rank higher in search. Send one business document; we check that the name and city match.
verify.photoHint: Clear and complete, with the business name readable.
verify.privacy: Only FMBP can see this document. It is never shown to other users.

errors.already_pending: Your document is already being checked.

admin.title: FMBP Admin

reports.dismissBody: Nothing wrong found. A hidden post shows again for everyone.

admin.removePostBody: “{{title}}” is removed for everyone. The owner is told the reason.
admin.suspendBody: The business and all its posts disappear for everyone, and it cannot post or chat. The owner sees the reason.
admin.unsuspendBody: The business and its posts show again. The owner is told.
admin.revokeBody: For example when a document turned out to be wrong. The business can send a new one.

verify.approveBody: Only if the name and city on the document match this business.
verify.rejectBody: Tell them what to fix (e.g. “Photo not readable”). They can send a new one.

admin.searchPlaceholder: Business name, phone number or post title

admin.broadcastWarning: Every user gets this on their phone. Use it rarely, for important news only (one broadcast per 10 minutes).
admin.broadcastCityHint: Leave empty to send to everyone.
